top_signal.title: Low-MOQ eco packaging vendors in the US? (100–200 units)
top_signal.summary: Starting a small clothing brand and looking for US vendors (ideally one place) for:     Recycled/recyclable  zipper  poly bags with a suffocation warning   Recycled poly mailers   Tissue paper, logo stickers and thank-you cards     I need  plain or simple one-color logo  versions at  100–200 units.  Most vendors require  10,000+  for custom printing, or put  their own logo  on stock items, which I’d rather avoid.   Any recommendations, or experiences with quality, pricing or lead times? Thanks!       submitted by     /u/A_garden       [link]       [comments]
